roster.name: Digital DJ Tips // Learn To DJ

ideas.title: Ninja DJ: stealth transition
ideas.image_alt: AI persona as a ninja DJ: black outfit, dark headband with tails, mask pulled down, gold-and-white headphones, hand over the mixer
script: 0–2s: decks playing song A, empty frame, text on screen: 'shh… 🥷'
2–6s: you sneak in low from the side of the frame in the ninja look (black outfit, headband tails, mask down around the neck, gold-and-white headphones)
6–9s: freeze for a beat, look straight into the camera, slowly raise one hand
9–12s: karate-chop the crossfader exactly on the drop; quick zoom-in and a whoosh sound; the beat switches to song B
12–18s: nod to the new track, then vanish out of frame (jump cut); the decks keep playing
Optional twist: swing two synth pedals tied by their cable like nunchucks, then stomp one to drop a filter sweep into song B
End text: 'comment a song for the next ninja drop'
ideas.caption: stealth mode: ON 🥷🎧 which drop should i sneak into next?

ideas.title: Cheap gear stress test
script: 0–2s: tight shot of your hand over the jog wheel, text on screen: 'cheap gear test'
2–8s: normal mix, then a hard backspin
8–15s: second backspin + echo out, react face to camera
15–20s: verdict text: 'it survived / it did not'
ideas.caption: would you trust this in a club? 👀

ideas.title: Two-genre transition
ideas.hook: "Nobody expected these two songs to blend…"
script: 0–3s: song A chorus playing, text: 'Song A → Song B?'
3–15s: show the EQ/filter moves up close
15–25s: the drop of song B lands; cut to your reaction
Last 2s: text 'part 2?'
ideas.caption: comment two songs and i'll try to blend them next 🎧

ideas.title: Rekordbox stems hack

modeled_on.title: using Stems for DJing has three big problems…

script: 0–3s: screen-record + face cam, big text hook
3–20s: show the wrong way (vocals clashing), then the stems fix (drop vocals on track A)
20–35s: play the clean result
End: 'save this for your next set'
ideas.caption: save this before your next set 💾

ideas.title: Synth pedal sound reveal

modeled_on.title: Jaw and brain still on the floor since exploring Verso Instruments

ideas.hook: "This pedal turns a boring loop into THIS"
script: 0–3s: play a dry, plain loop
3–5s: stomp the pedal on camera (close-up)
5–15s: the processed sound, slowly turn one knob
End: text 'dry vs wet — which one?'
ideas.caption: dry or wet? 🎛️ be honest

ideas.title: Learn one thing fast

modeled_on.title: Learn Music Theory 10X Faster than any Music University 🎹

ideas.hook: "The 1 DJ trick that makes your mixes sound pro"
script: 0–2s: hook text + you pointing at the mixer
2–20s: one trick only (e.g. phrase-matching: count 32 beats, mix on the 1)
20–28s: before vs after audio
End: 'follow for trick #2'
ideas.caption: trick #1 of 10 🔁

ideas.title: Read the crowd POV

modeled_on.title: How do DJs read a crowd and know exactly what to play next?

ideas.hook: "How DJs know what to play next 🧐"
script: 0–3s: POV shot from behind the decks
3–25s: voice-over 3 signals: heads nodding, people leaving the floor, phones out
25–35s: show the track you switch to
End: 'what do you watch for?'
ideas.caption: DJs, what do you look for? 👇

ideas.title: Weird controller, real skill

modeled_on.title: Mad Zach likes arcade buttons for a very specific, practical skill

ideas.hook: "I finger-drummed this whole beat on pads 🥁"
script: 0–2s: hands on pads, fast
2–15s: build the beat live, layer by layer
15–20s: zoom out to show the setup
End: text 'should I do a full set like this?'
ideas.caption: full set on pads? y/n

ideas.title: Crowd moment caption

modeled_on.title: been wanting to share this with you guys for a while now…

ideas.hook: "I wasn't ready for this drop at my house party"
script: 0–3s: phone clip from behind the decks right before the drop
3–12s: the drop + crowd/friends reacting
12–18s: cut to you laughing
Keep text minimal; the moment is the hook
ideas.caption: this is why i DJ 🫶

ideas.title: 8-deck challenge (mini)

modeled_on.title: The unedited version, no cuts. Using all 8 decks…

script: 0–3s: wide shot, text 'no cuts'
3–35s: one-take mix using every deck you have
Last 5s: stop, exhale, look at camera
ideas.caption: one take. how many mistakes did you spot? 👀
